answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 43036 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Seeking help from awaliya Question: My question going to shrine (Mazar) of Auliya kiram and seeking help from them or making them as mediator to Almighty Allah is right or wrong according to Quran and Sunnah? Answer ID: 43036 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 45/45/M=1434) One should not visit such Mazars (graves) where Shirk and Bid’ah is practiced and where men and women meet together. It is not lawful to seek help from Awliya. Yes, one can supplicate with their intermediation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
